attributes.description: Overview of Gmail events via reports API in Google Workspace.

params.markdown:
#### Overview

This dashboard gives visibility into the Gmail Reports data stream of Google Workspace, showing how message delivery and SMTP activity are recorded across the domain. It highlights the total number of Gmail events and the total message payload volume, along with the trend of events over time. It surfaces top users by activity, top recipients, and top source IPs. Use the controls above to filter by event action, event outcome, and user email. Together, these panels offer a mail-flow view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/google_workspace/overview)**
